features: Free online check of one PDF for four basics a screen reader needs first: tags, real text, a title, and a language. The check runs in your browser, so the file stays on your computer. No sign-up; one file up to 200 pages and 40 MB. To get PDFs or Office files built to meet WCAG 2.2, visit https://celsari.com/document-accessibility
title: Celsari Free Accessibility Checker
